note: Recast from the original description of Snyder 1926 (in English), where the species was placed in the subgenus Kalotermes (Rugitermes); it covers the dealate female and the soldier, and also mentions a male from the same nest. Type locality Cartago, Costa Rica; the holotype is a soldier (USNM 28729). Note that the same volume also contains Nasutitermes (Subulitermes) kirbyi, a different species that must not be confused with this one.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Eyes large, pronotum long and wide, legs for the most part dark; the soldier has fewer antennal segments than most species of Rugitermes, but the number varies greatly, 11—15 segments (12 in the holotype).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealate female: head black or extremely dark brown, smooth and shiny, with scattered long hairs; postclypeus white, faintly yellowish; labrum light chestnut, broadly rounded at the tip. Eyes greyish white, large, closer to the lower margin of the head than one eye diameter. Ocelli transparent, raised and projecting, slightly less than their short diameter from the eye. Antenna chestnut, the basal segments paler (broken after segment 10), moniliform, gradually longer and wider towards the tip; segment 3 slightly club-shaped, longer than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum yellow, contrasting strongly with the dark head and wing scales, wider than the head; anterior margin concave, the sides curving smoothly and narrowing to the posterior margin, which is shallowly concave; scattered long hairs. Legs dark brown, only the tips of the tibiae and the tarsi yellow. Abdominal tergites dark brown, each with a row of long hairs at its base; cerci dark, rather long. Measurements: total length of the dealate female 7 mm; head length (to the tip of the labrum) 2 mm; pronotum length 1.1 mm; hind tibia length 1.3 mm; eye long diameter 0.402 mm; head width (with the eyes) 1.6 mm; pronotum width 1.8 mm. The male from the same nest has a black pronotum and slightly smaller eyes, the other characters being the same.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light yellowish brown, darker anteriorly, widest posteriorly; long hairs dense near the coronal suture depression, sparser posteriorly; frons gently inclined. Eye spots transparent, large or small, narrow or wide, subelliptical, on the margin of the antennal socket. The width of the postmentum at its middle is only one third of the greatest anterior width. Antenna pale yellow, the basal segments darker, 12 segments; segment 3 club-shaped and much elongate, nearly as long as segments 4 and 5 together; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; the last segment short and slender, suboval. Mandibles black, only the base reddish brown and wide, the tip pointed and incurved; the left mandible with a pointed tooth at the proximal third, a molariform projection at the middle and another blunt molar at the base; the distal edge of the right mandible rough or slightly serrate, with two large pointed teeth near the base. Pronotum paler than the head, white with yellow, slightly wider than the head; anterior margin arcuately concave, the sides curving smoothly and narrowing to the posterior margin, which is convex with a shallow median concavity; scattered long hairs. Femora swollen. Abdominal tergites yellow, each with a row of long hairs. Measurements: total length of the soldier 7.5 mm; head length including the mandibles 4.1 mm; head length (to the anterior margin, without the mandibles) 2.6 mm; left mandible length 1.45 mm; pronotum length 0.95 mm; hind tibia length 1.2 mm; head width anteriorly 1.65 mm and posteriorly 1.85 mm; head height (at the middle) 1.6 mm; pronotum width 1.95 mm.
